about_the_game:
Be an otaku like Sayaka Hiwatari and learn more about World DE-1.5 with the Death end re;Quest: Code Z Deluxe Pack that includes the Digital Soundtrack, Digital Art Books, and the Death End Collection—a compilation of short stories written by scenario supervisor Makoto Kedouin!

The Deluxe Pack* includes:

• 4x PC Wallpapers (1920 x 1080, 2560 x 1440, 3840 x 2160)

• 9x Mobile Wallpapers

• Digital Soundtrack (32 tracks)

• 2x Soundtrack Inlay Art (1x English Inlay Art, 1x Japanese Inlay Art)

• 3x Digital Art Books

• Art Collection (15 pages)

• Character Art Collection (12 pages)

• Death End Collection (15 pages)

* You can access the Deluxe Pack contents in the game folder. Right-click the game in your Steam Library, select "Browse Local Files", then open the "Deluxe Assets" folder.

content_descriptors.notes: One of the digital art books contains the illustrations of the Death Ends from the game. They depict the characters dying in many ways usually covered in blood.
